stemMarkdown: A is 2 times as efficient as B. Working together, they complete a job in 10 days. In how many days can A alone complete the job? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Let B's rate be $r$ per day; A's rate is $2r$. Combined rate $= (2+1)r = 1/10$, so $r = \dfrac{1}{3\times10}$. A's rate $= 2r$, so A alone takes $\dfrac{1}{2r} = \dfrac{3\times10}{2} = 15.00$ days.
